bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EUROe has six reviewed issuer-native issuance routes: Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism, Arbitrum, and an independent Solana SPL mint. No current OFT/OToken, lockbox, escrow, adapter, peer, validator, or bridge-specific rate-limit machinery was identified at the catalogued token addresses, so no bridge representation is scored. Membrane's historical EUROe Ramp announcement mentions bridging platforms without naming a current route contract, controller, or conserved-supply invariant; Paxos now describes the product as redemption-only. That historical statement remains an explicit evidence gap under Bridge Risk rather than a fabricated route.
